hook.name: Pangea Fee Hook
hook.description: Charges a fixed fee (0.3%–5%, set once per pool at registration) in the pool's designated quote currency on buys and sells via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Exempts a designated dev buyer address from fees on the first buy. Restricts liquidity provision to a single locker address, and reverts swaps that would move the pool price beyond the registered launch range.
